name: CaseHardFlexDirectionColumnReverse
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "hard-flex-direction-column-reverse" (layout). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: flex-direction: column-reverse on the container
